data.name: Bapunu
data.gender_notes: Bapunu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bapu means 'Father' and Nu means 'Joy'. This name signifies the joy and happiness a mother feels towards her child. The name Bapunu carries the meaning “Mother's joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bapunu usually hope their child will grow to embody mother's joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Brings peace and harmony to the family
data.etymology: Bapunu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother's joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bapunu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
